versions.changelog:
Initial release of the sandbox-sdk skill.

- Enables secure, isolated code execution using Cloudflare Sandbox SDK.
- Supports lifecycle management, command execution, code interpretation, file operations, and port exposure.
- Biases knowledge and retrieval toward the latest Cloudflare documentation and examples.
- Provides configuration, setup, and integration guidance for AI code execution, CI/CD, and interactive environments.
- Offers quick reference and best practices for safe, scalable sandbox use.
